suggested_architecture_title: Two visual representations, one caption decoder

verified_against.inspection: Static code + JSON artifacts + weights_only=True CPU state dictionary; no model forward, GPU, training or inference.

one_sentence: A pretrained caption Transformer keeps its global ResNet50 image prefix and gains three gated cross-attention blocks over a shared memory of 49 spatial ResNet50 tokens and up to 36 Faster R-CNN region tokens.

frozen_encoders.name: ResNet50
frozen_encoders.preprocessing: EXIF RGB, proportional resize + centered padding to 224 x 224, ImageNet normalization
frozen_encoders.precision: Grid cached as float16, read as float32; actual prefix uses the original cached float32 global vector, not mean of already rounded grid.
frozen_encoders.sharing: Global vector and grid come from the same classification ResNet50; the detector has its own separate ResNet50-FPN backbone.

frozen_encoders.name: Faster R-CNN ResNet50-FPN
frozen_encoders.preprocessing: Original RGB in [0,1]; detector's internal aspect-preserving transform min_size=800,max_size=1333; detector inference float32
frozen_encoders.feature_extraction: Final detections -> score >=0.2 -> class-agnostic NMS IoU0.5 -> top36 -> re-pool final boxes -> two-layer ROI box head
frozen_encoders.fallback: Full-image ROI when no detections survive, so at least one valid region per image
frozen_encoders.caption_inputs: ROI feature vectors, normalized box coordinates and validity mask. No object labels, class words or detection scores are fed into the caption decoder.

trainable_visual_fusion.grid: Linear(2048,512) -> LayerNorm(512) -> add learned row + column + source-0 embeddings
trainable_visual_fusion.regions: Linear(1024,512) -> LayerNorm(512) -> add Linear(4,512)(normalized xyxy) + source-1 embedding; padded positions re-zeroed
trainable_visual_fusion.memory: Concatenate along tokens: [B,49+36,512]=[B,85,512] in padded batches; effective tokens 49+K with 1<=K<=36
trainable_visual_fusion.memory_mask: [B,85], False for every grid token and valid ROI; True for padded ROI. In PyTorch attention, True means ignore.
trainable_visual_fusion.position_order: Visual LayerNorm happens BEFORE adding position/source embeddings; no extra visual encoder stack or post-sum LayerNorm.
trainable_visual_fusion.sharing: The same fused visual memory is supplied as keys and values to all three decoder layers.

decoder_input.prefix: Linear(2048,512)(original global feature), prepended as position0; not multiplied by sqrt(512)
decoder_input.words: Embedding(10004,512,padding_idx=0) multiplied by sqrt(512); learned positions start at1
decoder_input.positions: Learned Embedding(34,512), added to prefix and word tokens; then dropout0.3
decoder_input.teacher_forcing: Input: <start>,w1,...,wN. Target: w1,...,wN,<end>. N<=32; text input length<=33; with image prefix total<=34.
decoder_input.self_attention_masks: Boolean upper-triangular causal mask (future tokens blocked), plus padding-key mask. The image prefix is always valid; all words can attend to it.

block.name: GatedCrossAttentionLayer, custom forward derived from nn.TransformerDecoderLayer
block.norm_order: Pre-norm for all three sublayers; each layer has independent norm1,norm2,norm3 and a scalar cross_gate
ordered_steps: q=LN2(u); c=multi-head cross-attention(q,M,M) with visual padding mask; v=u+tanh(g_l)*dropout(c)
block.cross_attention: Queries from every causal stream position (including global prefix); K,V are the full visual memory. No causal mask over visual positions.
block.gates: One learned scalar per decoder layer, tanh-bounded in (-1,1), not a per-image/per-token gate and not a sigmoid probability.
block.dropout_sites: MultiheadAttention attention probabilities, self/cross/FFN residual outputs; additional dropout between FFN ReLU and Linear2.

architecture.output: Discard image-prefix position -> final LayerNorm(512) -> dropout0.3 -> Linear(512,10004); raw logits [B,T,10004]. Output weights are separate from token embedding, not tied.
architecture.no_attention_map_claim: No attention heatmap is used as proof of localization; need_weights=False in the actual implementation.

recommended_slides.title: What does the decoder see?
recommended_slides.layout: Left: one photo splitting into two frozen blue encoder boxes. Top ResNet50 branches into global prefix [1x2048] and spatial grid [49x2048]. Bottom detector gives ROI vectors [Kx1024] plus boxes/mask. Middle orange trainable projections+LayerNorm+position/source additions. Right shared memory [85x512] feeding a 3-layer caption decoder. Draw a separate global-prefix arrow into the text stream, not into memory. Caption output on far right.

recommended_slides.title: Inside one decoder layer
recommended_slides.layout: Vertical residual stream: LN1 -> causal self-attention -> +; LN2 -> cross-attention Q from text,K/V from memory -> tanh(g_l) -> +; LN3 -> Linear512→2048,ReLU,dropout,Linear2048→512 -> +. Repeat x3; show final norm+vocabulary head outside repeated block.

color_legend.blue: Frozen visual encoders / cached numeric features

avoid: Do not draw one shared CNN for ResNet50 and detector; they have separate backbones.
Do not draw image labels as decoder inputs.
Do not describe fusion as simple averaging; it is token concatenation plus cross-attention.
Do not omit the retained global prefix.
Do not draw post-norm blocks or sigmoid gates.

three_main_formulas.title: Visual memory
three_main_formulas.latex: G_i=\mathrm{LN}_g(W_g f_i+b_g)+r_{row(i)}+c_{col(i)}+s_g,\quad R_j=\mathrm{LN}_r(W_r z_j+b_r)+W_b b_j+b_b+s_r,\quad M=[G;R]
three_main_formulas.plain: Project both feature types to512 dimensions, normalize, add geometry and source, concatenate tokens. Padded ROI rows are masked.

three_main_formulas.title: One pre-norm decoder block
three_main_formulas.plain: Read previous tokens, retrieve relevant visual features, transform the result; residual additions preserve the main stream. FFN=Linear2(Drop(ReLU(Linear1(.)))).

three_main_formulas.title: Teacher-forced training loss
three_main_formulas.plain: Token-averaged cross entropy includes <end>, ignores padding, and excludes the image-prefix output. The model receives raw logits; no softmax before CrossEntropyLoss.

warm_start.copied: Global image projection, token/position embeddings, masked self-attention, feed-forward layers, final norm and vocabulary output; source norm1 -> norm1, source FFN norm2 -> target norm3.
warm_start.extra_initialization: Grid projection is copied from the old global image projection. Cross-attention, cross LN2, ROI projection, visual norms/geometry/source embeddings are newly initialized. Three gates are reset tozero.
warm_start.why_zero: At initialization in eval mode with identical global features, cross residuals vanish and the transferred prefix model is preserved. Gate gradients can open the branch; initially the gated branch's other parameters do not receive loss gradients through the zero gate.
warm_start.equality_scope: Initialization equality is an eval-mode claim; dropout random-number consumption changes training-mode samples. This is not a new achieved validation score.

training_protocol.caption_choice: One randomly selected human caption per image per epoch, reproducible from seed+epoch; first caption fixed for validation loss. All original human captions used as metric references.
training_protocol.amp: CUDA float16 autocast + GradScaler; unscale before clipping; overflow step skipped with scale backoff
training_protocol.early_stopping: Configured patience3 on full-validation greedy CIDEr-D. Actual run was manually stopped during epoch14; it did not finish by early stopping.
training_protocol.checkpoint_selection: Best greedy checkpoint was epoch13; later controlled decoding comparison selected immutable epoch11 with beam5,alpha0 on validation.
training_protocol.trainable: Only decoder and fusion parameters. Both pretrained CNNs are frozen; training reads cached features.
training_protocol.time_scope: Recorded fusion active training about2h31m includes training,validation,checkpoint I/O and initial validation; excludes feature extraction,preflight,loading and paused downtime. It is additional training after the prefix warm start.
training_protocol.selection_metric: CIDEr-D through pycocoevalcap1.2 Cider(n=4,sigma=6); native scale, no extra multiplication. BLEU-1/BLEU-4 use corpus0..1. Shared project_regex_v1 normalization/tokenization, not official PTB leaderboard tokenization.
training_protocol.objective_vs_selection: Gradient updates minimize cross entropy; CIDEr-D is the validation selection metric, not a differentiable training loss.

generation_and_selection.start: Image inputs + <start> only; then previous model-predicted tokens. Human previous words are used only during training/loss evaluation.
generation_and_selection.stop: <end> or33 generation steps; padding and another <start> are forbidden.
generation_and_selection.ranking: Accumulated token log probabilities; GNMT length denominator ((5+L)/6)^alpha. Selected alpha0 means no length normalization. L includes EOS and excludes START.
generation_and_selection.validation_search: 2 fixed checkpoints x [greedy +3 widths x5 penalties]=32 controlled validation settings, batch64/AMP/device matched.
generation_and_selection.selection_sentence: Model and decoding selected on validation; test metrics reported.

limitations_for_speaker: This is a warm-started continuation, not a from-scratch architecture-only comparison; no matched continued-prefix control was completed.

The detector was pretrained on COCO detection data. Project test is held out from caption-decoder training, but comes from the same COCOtrain2017 source; exact original filtered detector training overlap was not reconstructed.
Single-seed experiments and different training devices/budgets do not establish a universal architecture ranking.
Keep architecture explanation separate from scores: CIDEr improvement alone does not prove the decoder attended to the correct region.
